text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 - Production inference latency spike in us-west. Paging @kevin. Affected: realtime/stream routes (p95 spike). War room: https://meet.redwood/rooms/war-1776543210
kevin: Ack @incident-bot — joining war room now.
kevin: Quick snapshot — spike started ~10:12 UTC, error rate low but request queues building on gpu-pool-us-west-2. Pulling perf graphs.
maria: Oncall here. Can we route new traffic to eu-fallback and trigger reserved pool scale? I can flip routing if needed.
jordan: If we route, confirm model compatibility — eu-fallback serves quantized v1-q; responses may differ slightly in long-context cases.
kevin: Good note. Immediate step: trigger autoscale + evict long prefix KV caches on affected nodes. Running:
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/gpu-pool-us-west --replicas=6
for node in $(nodes -l pool=us-west); do ssh $node 'systemctl restart inference-kvcache'; done
```
sam: :thumbsup: initiating autoscale now; who will draft the public-facing status blurb? Need impact + ETA.
ops-lead: I'll draft. Proposed blurb: "We are investigating increased latency affecting realtime generation in us-west. Some requests may experience degraded latency (10–30s). No data loss. Engineers are working on mitigation; next update in 15 minutes." ETA to mitigation ~10–20 minutes for autoscale + cache restarts. Notifying support.
kevin: Autoscale triggered, pods increasing. p50 trending to baseline, p95 still elevated but improving. Monitoring. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
jordan: If p95 isn't back in 15m, plan B is failover to eu-fallback + reduce logging/sample rates to lower CPU. That will trade latency for potential quality/log completeness.
incident-bot: Status page draft from ops-lead: "We are investigating increased latency impacting realtime generation in us-west. Some requests may see degraded latency; no data loss. Our engineers are mitigating and will update within 15 minutes." Approve? :eyes:
sam: Approve. I'll post to the status page and ping support to hold off on targeted customer DMs until we have clearer ETA.
maria: Quick Q — who owns customer comms if we need to escalate? @jordan?
jordan: I'll own customer comms for any targeted notices. For now we hold until we confirm failover or ETA >30m.
kevin: p95 improved from ~48s to ~18s after cache restart. Will monitor for 10 minutes and then decide to close or failover.
incident-bot: Reminder: if resolved, mark P1 resolved and assign postmortem owner. If ongoing, keep thread open.
kevin: Leaving open for postmortem. Assigning postmortem owner: @kevin. Criteria to close: p95 < 12s sustained for 10min. :white_check_mark:
